// Item 3 fixture (MATRICES § D, type Flux; § G, précision FLUX and Q8). Appended by
// tests/l0-pi-surface.test.ts to subagent-only/test-command.ts in a temporary copy: the flux list of § D
// is a fixed set of files. test-command.ts already imports CHAMPS_FLUX and FLUX from ./pi-adapt.ts.

// ── case: direct ──
export const fluxDirect = (e: any): boolean => e.type === "agent_start";

// ── case: optionnel ──
export const fluxOptionnel = (e: any): boolean => e?.type !== "agent_start";

// ── case: gauche ──
export const fluxGauche = (e: any): boolean => "agent_start" === e.type;

// ── case: lecture-resolue ──
export const fluxResolu = (e: any): boolean => e[CHAMPS_FLUX.type] === "agent_start";

// ── case: lecture-resolue-optionnelle ──
export const fluxResoluOptionnel = (e: any): boolean => e?.[CHAMPS_FLUX.type] === "agent_start";

// ── case: valeur-resolue ──
export const fluxValeur = (e: any): boolean => e.type === FLUX.message;

// ── case: bloc ──
import { BLOC_TEXTE } from "./pi-adapt.ts";
export const fluxBloc = (b: any): boolean => b?.[CHAMPS_FLUX.type] === BLOC_TEXTE;

// ── case: non-resolu ──
export const fluxInconnu = (e: any): boolean => e.type === FLUX.inexistant;
